scope: Read-only verification of the terminal guarded fetch stage; no Cargo command, network request, build, or ProgramTest was run.

guard_behavior.exit_status_basis: The guard checks the Cargo process status and raises on nonzero exit before its final target-directory check; the recorded terminal reason is only reachable after Cargo exited zero.
guard_behavior.target_entry_content_class: Rust compiler version and target-configuration probe metadata; no compiled object or crate artifact observed.
guard_behavior.stdout_stderr: not captured by the wrapper; Cargo diagnostic remains unknown
guard_behavior.interpretation: The terminal label is a guard classification, not evidence that Cargo fetch failed. The zero exit and sole rustc probe marker indicate the guard likely rejected normal Cargo compiler probing as build output; this is an inference from the wrapper control flow and preserved marker, not a reproduced Cargo run.

limitations: The receipt does not rerun Cargo and cannot recover the discarded Cargo stdout/stderr.

The package-cache inventory is a filesystem inventory, not a Cargo resolver result. The recorded zero Cargo exit is the evidence that the requested host fetch completed; 112 lockfile registry packages absent from this host stage are not individually classified by target reachability.
No source/runtime witness, persistence/finality, candidate-position, settlement, or economic admission is qualified.
Any new Cargo operation requires fresh Sol review and a separately versioned guard with explicit diagnostic capture and reviewed target-probe handling.
